summary: Frontend-only test of the category sidebar redesign (Layout.jsx) on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Roles tested: admin, company_admin (companyadmin1), hr@finance.app with both companies (company_admin @3YJW4A, manager @4GV4LG) and center_manager (cmtest_salary). Working: standalone Dashboard, 9 categories + System group, single-accordion, auto-expand of the active route's group with highlighting, favorites pin/unpin with persistence after reload, Recent (max 5, newest first, no duplicates, dashboard excluded), search (highlighting, parent category, arrow keys/Enter, click, Escape, empty state), collapse rail with persistence after reload, rail-grp/expand/rail-search expand the sidebar again, item and group badges, sidebar logout, mobile drawer and bottom nav, and 41/41 routes load with no page errors. RBAC is the same as before: I checked every role's visible items and search results against the old canSee rules from commit 0a09d00, and no role gained anything (0 extra items, 0 leaks in search). One critical bug: Ctrl/Cmd+K on desktop opens the hidden mobile Sheet. Its overlay darkens the page and blocks every click, and the search box does not get focus.

ui_bugs.issue: The handler always calls setMobileOpen(true). On desktop the Sheet content is md:hidden, but its overlay still covers the page: the screen darkens and all clicks are blocked (Playwright click on navgrp-toggle-grp_finance timed out). document.activeElement is BODY and typed text goes nowhere. The user has to press Escape to recover. Fix: only open the drawer when the screen is narrower than 768px; on desktop, expand the sidebar and focus the desktop input.

The desktop SidebarBody and the mobile-drawer SidebarBody share one searchRef. When the drawer mounts, the ref points to the hidden drawer input. When it unmounts, the ref becomes null, so focusSearch() / rail-search can no longer focus the desktop input. Use separate refs, or pick the visible input.

Category tooltips in the collapsed rail are cut off. The rail's scroll container has overflow-y:auto, which also clips horizontally. Hovering rail-grp-* shows no tooltip: elementFromPoint at the tooltip's position returns main-content. Render tooltips in a portal or with position:fixed, or use the shadcn Tooltip.

The header is shown when the stored list is non-empty, even if every entry is filtered out by itemIndex. Seen for company_admin: an empty 'RECENT PAGES' header with no items. Render it only when the filtered list has items. Related: while permissions are loading, can() fails open, so routes can be written to sb_recent before RBAC settles.

ui_bugs.component: Active state / breadcrumb on nested routes
ui_bugs.issue: On /hrms/financial-history, both nav-HRMS and nav-financial_history are highlighted (sb-link-active), and the breadcrumb shows 'HRMS' instead of 'Financial History'. Breadcrumb and auto-expand pick the first prefix match, not the longest one.
The pin is shown only on hover (opacity 0 otherwise), so on mobile, users cannot see how to pin a favorite. Add @media (hover:none) { .sb-pin { opacity:.6 } }.

A pinned item shows up twice with the same data-testid (nav-transactions in Favorites and in its group), and the desktop and drawer bodies share testids. Consider adding a fav- prefix to the Favorites copies.

issues: 'System & Administration' appears twice: as a section label and again as the only group header right below it.
At w-64, long uppercase category names wrap onto 2 lines (Organization Management, Finance & Accounting, Candidate / Student Management, etc.), which makes row heights uneven.
When a route auto-expands a group near the bottom (e.g. System), the sidebar does not scroll it into view.

action_items: CRITICAL: In the Ctrl/Cmd+K handler, call setMobileOpen(true) only when window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)') matches; on desktop, only expand the sidebar and focus the desktop input.
Give the desktop and drawer search inputs separate refs so focusSearch/rail-search keep working after the drawer has been mounted.
Fix the rail tooltips cut off by the overflow-y-auto container (use a portal, position:fixed, or the shadcn Tooltip).
Show the Recent/Favorites headers only when at least one visible item resolves; optionally skip recording recent pages while PermissionContext is still loading.
Use the longest-prefix match for the breadcrumb and active group, and pass `end` to the /hrms NavLink so Financial History alone is highlighted.

Pre-existing, not a regression, but important: company_admin gets ALL-false menu permissions from /api/auth/me/permissions because 'company_admin' is not in backend SYSTEM_ROLES (custom roles default to OFF). Company admins therefore see an EMPTY sidebar (only Logout). The old sidebar gated groups with the same can(), so it behaved the same way. Product decision needed.
critical_code_review_comments: canSee() is identical to the pre-redesign version (verified by diffing against commit 0a09d00). Group menu gates are the same; new per-item menu gates on system items (subscription/org/hr) match the groups they used to belong to.

Small RBAC gating difference: payment_dashboard moved from grp_dashboard (gated by menu 'dashboard') to grp_finance (gated by menu 'finance'). If an admin turns off 'dashboard' but leaves 'finance' on for a role, that role now sees Payment Dashboard, and the reverse also changes. No effect right now because no restriction rows exist for system roles, but strictly speaking this is not parity.
The new grp_mess gate can('mess') refers to a menu id that is not in the backend MENU_REGISTRY, so it always returns true. This matches the old behaviour (mess group was not gated).
Layout.jsx is 955 lines; split SidebarBody, SidebarRail and the nav config into separate modules (code-review guideline: over 700 lines).
Badge styling markup is repeated 3 times; extract a <Badge> helper.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core flows pass; Ctrl+K broken on desktop; rail tooltips clipped)

seed_data_creation: None. Only browser localStorage (sb_*) was changed in throwaway test browser contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation run starts with fresh localStorage. Item badges show up only after /api/tasks/my resolves, so wait ~2s. RBAC check method: replicate the old canSee flags in Python, open each navgrp-toggle in [data-testid=desktop-sidebar], and compare the visible nav-* items. Results: center_manager sees 22 items + dashboard; manager (hr@ 2nd company) sees no dashboard, programs or financeOnly items, but does see partner_settlement and partner_ratings; company_admin sees an empty sidebar (pre-existing permissions default). Retest: Ctrl+K on desktop (no overlay; desktop input focused), rail tooltips, rail-search after Ctrl+K.
rca of the issue: Ctrl+K: the keydown handler in Layout.jsx calls setMobileOpen(true) on every screen size. Radix Sheet renders a fixed inset-0 overlay plus focus trap, and only SheetContent has md:hidden. Result on desktop: an invisible modal that blocks clicks and takes focus. searchRef is shared between the two SidebarBody instances, so it attaches to the hidden drawer input. Fix: check the viewport before opening the drawer, and use separate refs for the two inputs.
